answer_sql:
SELECT
  p.product_name,
  SUM(s.quantity) AS quantity_sold
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
JOIN contoso_served.dim_product AS p
  ON s.product_key = p.product_key
GROUP BY
  p.product_name
ORDER BY
  quantity_sold DESC
LIMIT 3
